microprocessor.name: SRC-TCP [Module] Passenger Lighting v1.4-C0.dev
microprocessor.description: Connects to passenger module. Controls lights in passenger cars

node.label: RGB Lights
node.description: Ouputs RGB values to RGB lights // Channels: N1: Red (0-1); N2: Green (0-1); N3: Blue (0-1);

node.label: Lighting UI
node.description: Connects to instruments or display controller // Channels: B4: Enable lights (toggle); B5: RGB (off) / HSV (on) (toggle); B6: He

node.label: Lights
node.description: Turns on non-rgb lights if lights are set to greater than the standard lights threshold

function setC(v) sC(v[1],v[2],v[3]) end

o=math.max(d.w/2-14,29) tA=onTouch(o,24,7,33) tB=onTouch(o+11,24,7,33) tC=onTouch(o+22,24,7,33) u = tA or tB or tC

function setC2(v) setC({v.a*100,v.b*100,v.c*100}) end

function dHeat(x,y) dR(x,y,4,2) dR(x+2,y,4,2) end
s=screen;sC=s.setColor;dTF=s.drawTriangleF;dR=s.drawRect;dRF=s.drawRectF;dT=s.drawText;dTB=s.drawTextBox;dL=s.drawLine; function onDraw() w=s.getWidth() h=s.getHeight() setC(theme.bg2) s.drawClear()
setC(theme.fg) dL(6,24,6,33) if light then dRF(6,24,19,9) setC(theme.bg2) end dT(9,26,"l") if not light then setC(theme.acc) end dLgt(15,27)

end

gN=input.getNumber;gB=input.getBool;sN=output.setNumber;sB=output.setBool; function onTick()
-- bools
-- doors sB(1,gB(4)) -- left sB(2,gB(5)) -- right sB(3,gB(6)) -- open
-- heater sB(25,gB(7))
-- numbers
-- doors enc(4, 6,clamp(gN(4),0,63)) -- first enc(10,6,clamp(gN(5),0,63)) -- last
-- lighting enc(16,3,clamp(gN(6),0,1)*7) -- r enc(26,2,(clamp(gN(6),0,1)-math.floor(clamp(gN(6),0,1)*7)/7)*21) -- dr enc(19,3,clamp(gN(7),0,1)*7) -- g enc(28,2,(clamp(gN(7),0,1)-math.floor(clamp(gN(7),0,1)*7)/7)*21) -- dg enc(22,3,clamp(gN(8),0,1)*7) -- b enc(30,2,(clamp(gN(8),0,1)-math.floor(clamp(gN(8),0,1)*7)/7)*21) -- db
end
-- encode an integer n on channel c with b bits -- the first bit is the lsb function enc(c,b,n) for i=0,b-1 do n = math.floor(n) sB(c+i,n%2 == 1) n = n/2 end end
function clamp(v,x,y) return math.min(math.max(v,x),y) end

gN=input.getNumber;gB=input.getBool;sN=output.setNumber;sB=output.setBool; function onTick()
-- bools
-- doors sB(4,gB(1)) -- left sB(5,gB(2)) -- right sB(6,gB(3)) -- open
-- heater sB(7,gB(25))
-- numbers
-- doors sN(4,dec(4, 6)) -- first sN(5,dec(10,6)) -- last
-- lighting sN(6,dec(16,3)/7+dec(26,2)/21) -- r sN(7,dec(19,3)/7+dec(28,2)/21) -- g sN(8,dec(22,3)/7+dec(30,2)/21) -- b
end
-- decode an integer from channel c with b bits -- the first bit is the lsb function dec(c,b) n = 0 for i=1,b do n = n*2 n = n+(gB(c+b-i) and 1 or 0) end return n end
